skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding steps in criminal case resolution process
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the procedural steps in resolving criminal cases, including authority, procedure, and process.
Analyze the stages of criminal proceedings, including authority, procedures, and processes for specific criminal cases.
Apply communication, presentation, and public speaking skills.
Apply problem-solving skills to legal issues during criminal case resolution.
Develop self-directed learning abilities, accumulating and enhancing knowledge.
